summary: EuroDry Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 6, 2026, reporting its results for the quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026. The press release details net revenues, net income, adjusted EBITDA, and fleet utilization. It also notes a share repurchase plan continuation (up to $10 million, about $5.8 million used) and a new refinancing term sheet with Alpha Bank for up to $19 million. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation transaction. The only notable items are ordinary capital allocation and financing activities, not transformative events.
